models.title: Domtoren Utrecht | Architecture study
models.description: Editable 1:500 CAD massing study of Utrecht's 112.32 m Domtoren, including true pointed through-passage, tiered square stages, an open octagonal lantern and a small eight-sided spire. Outline and facade details remain illustrative.

models.title: Rijksmuseum Amsterdam
models.description: Architectural 3D study of Pierre Cuypers' Rijksmuseum: twin towers, open central passage, roof ridges, galleries, stone bands and glazing. Editable native CAD geometry; illustrative proportions.
